max_label_chars.label: Maximum label characters
max_label_chars.description: Maximum characters shown from each workspace name. Use 0 to show the full name.

hide_inactive.label: Hide inactive workspaces
hide_inactive.description: Hide populated special workspaces unless they are currently visible on a monitor.

capsule_radius.label: Capsule radius
capsule_radius.description: Corner radius of each capsule in logical pixels. Values below 0 are treated as 0.

capsule_padding.label: Capsule content padding
capsule_padding.description: Space before and after the label along the bar axis, in logical pixels. Values below 0 are treated as 0.

capsule_min_width.label: Capsule minimum length
capsule_min_width.description: Minimum capsule length along the bar axis: width on horizontal bars, height on vertical bars. Values below 0 are treated as 0.

active_style.label: Active workspace style
active_style.description: Show active workspaces as primary-filled capsules or transparent labels with primary text.

inactive_style.label: Inactive workspace style
inactive_style.description: Show inactive workspaces as secondary-filled capsules or transparent labels with surface text.
